title: TAVI API trace — idle timeout 2 min (SessionPolicyTest SP-04, 25 Oct 2026, 2nd run)
lines: Two fresh sign-ins: BUSY session calls GET /iam/me every 30 s; IDLE session makes no calls
30 s   busy GET /iam/me -> 200   Login History: busy=active  idle=active
180 s   busy -> 401               busy=active  idle=active   <- the busy session is signed out
END     idle token 401 / refresh 401;  busy token 401 / refresh 401
Login History still lists both sessions as "active" after they stopped working
PUT idle_timeout_minutes = 60 -> 200   (restored; same result in the 1st run)
